Commit 42e293a on wt/skeleton. Module tree + full CLI surface, green under cargo fmt / clippy --all-targets -D warnings / test (10 tests).

Spec lines satisfied:
- 'Commands (all --json; human digest second) — sessions / at / grep / explain / doctor': src/cli.rs declares all five with --repo/--since/--until/--agent/--ts/--window/--event-line and a global --json; each parses and exits 2 with 'unimplemented — flags parsed, no work done yet'. src/main.rs is the only mod declaration site; no later bead adds a mod or a subcommand.
- 'Connector trait (discover() -> Vec<SessionMeta>, read(path) -> Vec<Turn>) so a third is one file — but do not add one': src/connector/mod.rs, plus roots() for doctor and a fixed two-entry registry(). Return types are Vec not Result, which is how 'one bad line never fails a file' is enforced rather than promised.
- 'discover() -> Vec, read(path) -> Vec' / model bead fold-in: src/model.rs is real — Role, Turn, SessionMeta{path,cwd,first_ts,last_ts,turn_count,parse_failures,connector}, TimeWindow{overlaps,contains,around}, Confidence, Evidence/Signal, parse_duration (pact's spellings), parse_ts, parse_when. Module doc records why cwd is Option and why timestamps are chrono DateTime<Utc>. round_trips_through_serde_json covers every type.
- 'Scored match that always reports confidence and evidence, never a bare answer': model::Confidence + Evidence/Signal, consumed by join::Match; join::Refusal has exactly the spec's two variants with reason() returning 'no cwd match' / 'no overlap'.
- '--repo resolves to the project's encoded session directories (repo + worktrees) before any file opens': src/worktree.rs (worktrees/session_dirs/encode/for_cwd, Worktree.alive for the pruned case).
- 'sessions are append-only, so mtime prunes files outside the query window unopened': src/prune.rs partition() -> Partition{opened,skipped}, module doc states the one-sided argument.
- 'recount reads .pact/events.jsonl directly (tolerant, chain_hash ignored)': src/pact_events.rs Event/Events/read/events_path, 1-based line addressing with Events::line(n) and line_count for the out-of-range message.

Decisions the spec did not settle (reported to orchestrator): discover() takes (dirs, window) so scoping reaches the connector before it opens anything; --window is half-width either side of --ts; --since/--until accept rfc3339 or a duration-ago while --ts stays strict rfc3339; doctor takes an optional --repo defaulting to '.'; crate-level allow(dead_code) with a ponytail comment until W3 lands.

docs/format-notes.md committed as e13629b on wt/formatnotes. Full empirical scan of ~/.claude/projects on 2026-08-19: 48 project dirs, 871 JSONL files, 169,775 lines, 754.7 MB. Encoding rule derived from real cwd fields and verified on 41/48 dirs: every non-[A-Za-z0-9] char -> a single '-', case preserved; LOSSY and non-injective (/ . _ + and literal - all collapse), so --repo must encode forward and never decode. 19 line kinds tabulated with counts; assistant 85031 / user 49039 carry cwd+timestamp+role+content, the other 15 kinds never carry cwd and 12 never carry a timestamp; journal.jsonl holds only started/result and is the sole source of the 29 zero-cwd files. Pathologies: 0 bad lines, 0 truncated tails, 0 empty files, but 12 lines >=1MB and one of 16.4MB. Time: RFC3339 UTC ms, non-monotonic in 246/842 files (worst inversion 12h), mtime never precedes the last turn (0/842) so mtime pruning is sound but can overshoot by 22 days. Biggest finding, sent to orchestrator as pact-msg-87adb6361c3ba806: cwd is the process cwd, so pact-style wt/<agent> worktrees never appear in it and the spec's invoked_from->worktree->cwd join does not resolve for the fleet recount audits; the transcript-mention signal and the subagent .meta.json description must be the primary keys.
